capabilities.summary: Core SAT math question generation capability: accepts an InceptBench-compatible request, runs the LLM generation pipeline via asyncio.gather, stores produced assets in GCS, and returns the question JSON. Also exposes a GET introspection endpoint listing supported parameters.

preliminary_evidence.claim: POST /generate triggers the generation pipeline with asyncio.gather and writes results to GCS
GET /generate returns a contract summary describing supported POST parameters

capabilities.summary: GCS-backed asset browser: renders HTML pages to navigate bucket directories, proxies raw object bytes for download, displays image assets, renders Markdown articles from GCS, and provides a bulk sync CLI to upload the local curricula directory.

integrations: Google Cloud Storage (object read, directory listing)

preliminary_evidence.claim: GET /browse renders an HTML Jinja2 page listing GCS bucket objects at a given prefix
GET /object/{key} streams raw GCS object bytes as a proxy download
sync_sat_to_gcs.py walks curricula/SAT/ and uploads all files to GCS bucket

splitting_check.split_justification: All five surfaces share a single GCS read/listing concern and the Jinja2 template layer; splitting would fragment a coherent browsing capability.

capabilities.summary: SVG diagram generation from scene descriptions or question data: accepts a scene JSON body via HTTP POST or CLI and returns an SVG via an LLM-backed pipeline. Includes a microservice mode (port 8001) and a question-oriented image generation endpoint.

preliminary_evidence.claim: POST /render accepts a scene JSON body and returns a rendered SVG diagram
POST /image/fromQuestion generates an SVG asset from a SAT math question object

splitting_check.split_justification: All surfaces belong to the single svg-gen component with a shared rendering pipeline; the health endpoint and CLI serve entrypoints are ancillary to the same capability.

capabilities.summary: SVG rasterization to PNG using a headless Playwright/Chromium renderer: accepts SVG content via HTTP POST or CLI and returns PNG bytes. Runs as a standalone microservice on port 8002. Also supports batch directory conversion and single-file conversion via CLI commands.

preliminary_evidence.claim: POST /convert accepts SVG content and returns PNG bytes via Playwright/Chromium rendering
convert-batch CLI command converts all SVGs in a directory to PNGs

splitting_check.split_justification: All surfaces are part of the svg-to-image component with a single Playwright rendering concern; batch and serve modes are operational variants of the same rasterization capability.

capabilities.summary: AI image generation from text prompts via the OpenAI API: accepts a prompt and returns a PNG. Available as an HTTP microservice (port 8003) or CLI. Used for producing photorealistic math context images in the generation pipeline.

preliminary_evidence.claim: POST /generate accepts a prompt JSON body and returns PNG bytes via OpenAI
image-gen generate CLI writes a PNG from a text prompt via OpenAI

capabilities.summary: SAT question bank acquisition and local serving: downloads topic bundles from InceptCurriculum API to local JSON, then serves them via a FastAPI server with topic listing, topic detail, PDF view, and PDF download endpoints for browser and programmatic access.

preliminary_evidence.claim: download CLI fetches SAT question bundles from InceptCurriculum API and saves as local JSON
GET /api/topics returns JSON list of all available SAT topic bundles by assessment type

splitting_check.split_justification: Although there are 8 surfaces, they form a single coherent dev-time capability: download then browse. The download CLI feeds the serve command; splitting fetch from serve would create a meaningless half-capability.

capabilities.summary: Local developer tool for viewing rendered SAT math questions as HTML: serves a FastAPI web page on port 7890 that displays question content with SVG and HTML assets rendered server-side, allowing engineers to visually inspect generated question output during development.

preliminary_evidence.claim: GET / renders an HTML page for viewing SAT math questions with SVG/HTML assets server-side
question-viewer serve CLI starts local FastAPI server on port 7890

capabilities.summary: Health check and root info endpoints across all deployed services: the main API exposes GET /health and GET / for liveness probing and service identification. These surfaces are used by Cloud Run and load balancers to verify the service is running before routing traffic.

preliminary_evidence.claim: GET /health returns JSON health status for Cloud Run liveness probing
GET / returns a root JSON welcome/info response from the main FastAPI application

capabilities.summary: CLI utility for uploading individual files to a Google Cloud Storage bucket with optional content-type override. Provides the gcs-uploader component as a reusable building block consumed by both the main generation pipeline and the bulk sync script.

preliminary_evidence.claim: gcs-uploader upload CLI uploads a local file to a GCS bucket path with optional content-type

proposed_domains.name: generation
proposed_domains.justification: Encapsulates the core business logic of generating SAT math questions via the LLM pipeline, tying together question prompting, asset production, and GCS persistence.

proposed_domains.name: asset-browser
proposed_domains.justification: Groups the GCS-backed file browsing and viewing surfaces that allow engineers and evaluators to inspect generated question assets stored in the bucket.

proposed_domains.name: svg
proposed_domains.justification: Contains both the scene-to-SVG generation capability and the SVG-to-PNG rasterization capability — two distinct but tightly related steps in the math diagram production pipeline.

proposed_domains.name: image
proposed_domains.justification: Covers AI-driven photorealistic image generation from text prompts via OpenAI, a separate concern from the vector SVG diagram pipeline.

proposed_domains.name: question-bank
proposed_domains.justification: Groups the InceptCurriculum question acquisition and local serving surfaces used to supply training and evaluation data for question generation.

proposed_domains.name: devtools
proposed_domains.justification: Captures local developer utilities (question viewer) that aid inspection and debugging of generated output but are not part of the production API surface.

proposed_domains.name: infra
proposed_domains.justification: Holds cross-cutting operational surfaces — health checks, root info endpoints, and GCS upload tooling — that support deployment and CI/CD without belonging to a business-logic domain.
